provenance: v2 ONLY. Every entry here was produced by a process-v2 run and graded by the user. The v1 library (13 accepted + 4 rejected, harvested from pre-v2 hand processing) was discarded 2026-07-30 because a reference profile is only meaningful for the pipeline that has to hit it. It is recoverable from git history; do NOT reuse its numbers.
profiler: scripts/profile.js v3 (stride ~40k samples, native scale, tile grid 6, significant-figure output)
metricDefs: skyBand = the band holding the most samples (the background population). skyBandSat = its saturation.
grainRelSky = MAD of the 2px difference image divided by sky p25.
structure.RoverG / RoverB = channel-delta ratios above sky level; the object's colour trend.
Relative saturation is noise-inflated below L~0.05; apply a level floor when reading dark-sky bands.
rules: USER-GRADED ONLY. An entry needs verdict + gradedBy 'user'. A run's own numbers go in its RUNLOG, never here. Self-assessment is what made the old auto-select unreliable.
NATIVE SCALE ONLY. scale must be '1:1'. grainRelSky reads 1.91x LOW at 4x downsample, so a proxy-measured entry is poison, not an approximation.

REJECTS NEED FULL NUMBERS. A reject carries the same complete metric set as an accepted entry, plus failure + lesson. Two v1 rejects had a lesson and no ladder, so nothing could ever be scored against them. A reject without numbers is a note, not a reference.
THRESHOLDS ARE PER CLASS. Never compare or borrow across classes.

A CLASS GATES ONLY AT >= 3 accepted AND >= 1 rejected. Below that the class is in calibration: the driver reports absolute metrics and spans a deliberate spread, and computes no class distance. n=1 is a point, not a range.
PROFILER REV IS PART OF THE MEASUREMENT. Compare only within one profilerRev; a profiler change requires re-measuring, not reinterpreting.

entryContract.name: <target>_<variant>_<yyyy-mm-dd>
entryContract.extent: full | crop (crop entries record the rect and its match quality)
entryContract.failure: rejected only: what the user objected to, in their words where possible
entryContract.lesson: rejected only: which metric or path fact separates it from an accepted entry, or 'none, global metrics blind to this' if none does
